id_requirements: Government-issued photo ID required for Pearson VUE exams (NSE 4 and above). NSE 1-3 are completed online via the Fortinet training portal with no external ID verification.
exam_rules: NSE 4 and above: Closed-book exam via Pearson VUE. No notes, study materials, or electronic devices permitted. Personal items must be stored. No food or drink. NSE 1-3: Free online self-paced assessments; no proctoring. NSE 8 includes a separate written exam and an 8-hour hands-on practical lab.
renewal_options: NSE 4 through NSE 8 certifications are valid for 3 years. Renewal requires earning CE credits through Fortinet's continuing education program or retaking the current exam version. NSE 1-3 are valid for 2 years and renewed by retaking the free assessments.
target_audience: Fortinet employees or candidates sponsored by an ATC
recommended_experience: Five years of relevant experience in network security and cybersecurity; five years of experience in training delivery in IT security; certification in the required NSE training courses

retake_policy.notes: 30-day waiting period between retake attempts for NSE 4 through NSE 7. NSE 1-3 may be retaken immediately. NSE 8 retake policies are scheduled separately through Fortinet.

editorial.meta_description: FCP_FAZ_AD-7.4 is retired as of 2025-10-14. Review details for this Fortinet exam and its successor, NSE 6 - FortiAnalyzer 7.6 Administrator.
editorial.overview: The NSE 5 Network Security Analyst — FortiAnalyzer examination, designated by code FCP_FAZ_AD-7.4 and certified by Fortinet, covered administrative tasks and management features for FortiAnalyzer deployments across multiple domains. Fortinet officially retired this examination on 2025-10-14. Candidates seeking certification paths now pursue the NSE 6 - FortiAnalyzer 7.6 Administrator instead.
editorial.who_should_take: Network security professionals, enterprise system administrators, and technical support engineers who are directly responsible for configuring, managing, and monitoring complex FortiAnalyzer deployments within enterprise production environments.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Carefully review official Fortinet training and study documentation covering deployment procedures, log storage policies, event handlers, and high availability settings in detail. Perform practical laboratory exercises focused on administrative domains, log routing, and system monitoring to master each exam domain before taking any official assessment.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers fundamental deployment procedures and initial configuration tasks for FortiAnalyzer units, including setting up administrative access, managing licenses, and configuring system settings carefully for standard operational environments.

Focuses on advanced log management, storage allocation, and data retention policies, detailing how logs are safely received, parsed, stored, and managed on the disk effectively across various enterprise architectures.

Examines FortiView dashboards, custom event handlers, and threat monitoring tools designed specifically to analyze network traffic, security events, and indicators of compromise broadly within diverse organizational infrastructure implementations.

Covers report generation, custom chart creation, datasets, and analytics tools used to extract data from logs and produce scheduled administrative reports reliably for executive review and operational auditing.

This detailed domain explicitly addresses high availability configurations, log synchronization, configuration synchronization, and failover management required for reliable and stable FortiAnalyzer deployments across standard corporate networking infrastructure and enterprise production environments.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Because FCP_FAZ_AD-7.4 is retired, candidates cannot register for this specific test code. Instead, register for the successor NSE 6 - FortiAnalyzer 7.6 Administrator exam and review its testing policies.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The official examination contains a total of 30 multiple-choice questions designed specifically to assess administrative knowledge and practical configuration skills across all specified domains and objectives.
The passing score for the certification test is set precisely at 70 percentage points, which registered candidates must achieve in order to successfully pass the evaluation.
During the formal testing session, registered candidates are given a total duration of exactly 70 minutes to complete all questions included without any exceptions whatsoever.

faq.question_title: What is the replacement exam for the retired test?
faq.answer_text: Fortinet retired this examination and designated NSE 6 - FortiAnalyzer 7.6 Administrator as the official successor path for candidates pursuing professional certification in this domain.

methodology.summary: This page was built carefully using verified facts and official Fortinet study documentation and objectives to provide accurate details regarding the retired certification exam.
